images.name: DK-A2
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE 1024x1536 portrait character model sheet for building and rigging one consistent male dark knight, four full-body orthographic views on flat pure #00ff00, in a 2x2 grid with no borders, text, labels, ground or shadows.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: copy the varying crisp dark sepia-to-near-black ink contours, fine hand-drawn hatching, transparent watercolor pooling, granulation, soft blooms and cream paper highlights. Copy none of its character, costume, props or pose. Image 2 is LAYOUT ONLY: copy its four-view grid and relaxed A-pose arrangement, never its wearer or clothing. Image 3 is PLATE PAINTING ONLY: copy how ink and transparent watercolor depict plate, never its design, colors, helmet or wearer.

REGISTER: subject and ornament draw on late-medieval and early-Renaissance illuminated manuscripts c.1400–1530, rendered in hand-painted watercolor-and-ink character illustration of 1990s tactics role-playing games. Washes unevenly pool at edges, granulate and bloom; occasionally stop short of or overrun contours. Shadows use second transparent washes and fine hand hatching, never smooth gradients. Slightly wavering varying-weight DARK pen line is the darkest mark. Pale cream bare-paper highlights. One hand-painted illustration, not a photograph or digital painting. Soft even daylight from screen upper-left. No dramatic lighting, rim light, cast shadows, lens effects, glossy highlights. Special figure exception: near-black violet-indigo armor and dark cape, fine gold filigree and faint violet eye-slit glow are required. Preserve layered transparent washes and pale edge highlights rather than solid black fills.

CHARACTER: a towering tall elongated elegant male sorcerous dark knight, about eight and a half heads tall, long legs, narrow waist, lean commanding silhouette, straight still posture. Full plate head to foot, near-black steel with deep violet-indigo sheen in watercolor washes. Fine thin scrolling gold filigree along plate edges, never broad solid gold surfaces. Completely closed full face-concealing visor with one narrow horizontal eye slit and faint violet glow inside. No face, skin or hair anywhere. Two long dark horns sweep backward and upward from helmet sides; exactly the same pair, curve and attachment points in every view. Tall flaring symmetrical pauldrons, EXACTLY THREE overlapping lames on EACH shoulder, rising to a point above shoulder line and flaring outward. Sculpted breastplate tapering to narrow waist, plated fauld over hips, segmented arm plates, articulated gauntlets, plated legs, pointed sabatons. Hands empty, belt empty; no weapons, shield or scabbard.

ASYMMETRY: one broad GOLD FILIGREE BAND encircles anatomical LEFT forearm plate ONLY. Anatomical RIGHT forearm is plain dark steel, with no broad band. Front view: band on viewer's RIGHT arm. Back view: band on viewer's LEFT arm. Left side profile: visible near forearm has band. Right side profile: visible near forearm plain dark steel; any visible far left forearm retains its band. This is one knight rotated, not mirrored.

CAPE: short stiff close-fitting deep indigo-black cloth with thin gold border, attached UNDER pauldrons. Hem stops at BOTTOM OF SHOULDER BLADES, clearly ABOVE waist. Identical cape length and shape in all four views. Never a waist-length or long cape.

LAYOUT: top-left FRONT facing viewer; top-right RIGHT SIDE in exact profile facing screen RIGHT; bottom-left BACK directly from behind; bottom-right LEFT SIDE in exact profile facing screen LEFT. Consistent bodily dimensions in all four views, centered in each quarter, horns and soles fully visible with margins. Soles align to one common baseline per row. All four figures fill most of each quarter's height.

POSE: relaxed A-pose, arms straight and held away from body about 30 degrees. Clear uninterrupted green gap between each arm and torso AND between each arm and cape in front and back views. Hands OPEN, fingers together and straight, palms facing thighs. Legs straight, feet slightly apart pointing forward. Head level facing body direction. Preserve this identical pose when rotating into profiles. No accidental tangencies or overlaps between separate sheet views.

CRITICAL consistency: exactly the same helmet, horns, three-lame pauldrons, anatomical-left forearm band, shoulder-blade-length cape, armor construction and proportions across four views. Pure flat #00ff00 background.

concerns: Initial image has a dark gradient background and apparent shoulder-lame drift; retained as instructed.
Retry improves shoulder consistency and provides a green background, but exact #00ff00 uniformity was not verified.
Cape hems appear lower than the requested bottom-of-shoulder-blades limit.
